user_input: How can meditation contribute to stress management and overall well-being according to wellness practices?
reference: Meditation is a key component of mindfulness, which is the practice of being fully present and engaged in the current moment. Regular mindfulness practice, including meditation, has been shown to reduce stress, improve focus, and enhance emotional regulation. Basic mindfulness meditation involves finding a quiet place, focusing on your breath, and gently returning your attention to it when your mind wanders. There are various types of meditation, such as focused attention, body scan, loving-kindness, walking meditation, and guided meditation, all of which can aid in stress management and contribute to overall well-being.
